chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I heard Al-Reza (peace be upon him) saying: 'Yawning is from the Satan and the sneeze is from Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual origin of yawning and sneezing in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) distinguishes the metaphysical origins of common physical acts, attributing yawning to the influence of Shaytan and sneezing to Allah. This classification informs the etiquette of responding to sneezes with 'Alhamdulillah' while guarding against yawning to prevent the entry of Shaytan, reflecting a holistic view of bodily actions as spiritual indicators.
